SEARCH
Package presentation.views.home

Class StoreView

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
presentation.views.View
presentation.views.home.HomeView
presentation.views.home.StoreView
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class StoreView extends HomeView
Store of the game, with three tabs: characters and balls (to buy) and upgrades (stats of each player). It only paints: prices, locks, points and stats come from the domain through the GUI.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda

    • setPlayerStats

      public void setPlayerStats(int side, int points, int[] levels, int[] nextCosts)
      Shows the points and the stats of one player in the upgrades tab.
      Parameters:
      side - 0 = player 1, 1 = player 2
      points - points of the player, or -1 if the domain can't give them yet
      levels - level of each stat (speed, jump, kick, survival)
      nextCosts - cost of the next upgrade of each stat, or -1 if it is at the max
